action_items: Consider ensuring the seed vet1/vet2 accounts land with onboarded=true so demos/tests don't get bounced to /onboarding on first /app navigation.

TestStripe.test_plans_public in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still asserts the OLD lookup_keys (solo/clinic/multisite) and OLD amounts (4900/19900/49900); it will fail against the new pricing. Update or delete that assertion set. (Not fixed here — outside iter-4 scope, only reporting.)
critical_code_review_comments: twilio_service._validate_signature falls open when TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN is empty — correct for dev but should log a warning once at startup so it's visible if it accidentally ships to prod.

twilio_service.provision uses TWILIO_VOICE_WEBHOOK_BASE from PUBLIC_APP_URL env; when unset the endpoints are provisioned with voice_url=None which will 404 in production. Add a guard that refuses to provision when PUBLIC_APP_URL is empty.

tryit_service.scrape_clinic swallows non-HTTP errors as HTTPException(400) which is fine, but doesn't rate-limit; a malicious client can spam /api/marketing/try-it (no auth) with arbitrary URLs. Add IP rate limiting + URL allowlist (block private IPs / metadata endpoints) to prevent SSRF.

stripe_service.checkout_bundle uses BUNDLE_COUPON_ID string discount but the coupon in ensure_catalog is only created if scribe product exists in the batch; if ensure_catalog runs before scribe product is created it silently no-ops. Acceptable — ensure_catalog is idempotent so a redeploy fixes it.
server.py is ~1000 lines now (up from ~700) — inbox/tasks/care-gaps and receptionist should move into their own routers/modules for maintainability.
